ri_yosemite_boulder.blurb: Yosemite Boulder is one big block in the Lincoln Woods boulder field north of Providence, set a little apart from the busier central cluster. It carries about two dozen problems spread across every face, from a few easy crack and slab lines near the bottom of the scale up to a handful of very hard tests in the V8 to V11 range. The wall is not especially steep, so much of the harder climbing is technical face work, with eliminates adding extra variations. Several lines are tall enough to feel like highballs. The granite is coarse and textured, and the woodland setting keeps it shaded and quiet compared with the roadside boulders.

ri_split_rock.blurb: Split Rock is the signature block of the Druid's Circle group at Lincoln Woods, a boulder cleaved by a wide gap that you can scramble into. Two dozen problems cover its faces, and most sit between V1 and V3, which makes it friendly for climbers moving up from the easy grades. A long crack-line traverse crosses the front, while the back side overhangs and holds a famous sit-start traverse. The grade range reaches a few harder lines up to about V8. Granite here is coarse and grippy, and the surroundings are open woods a short walk from the paved loop.

ri_warm_up_cave.blurb: Despite its name, the Warm Up Cave is mostly a testpiece wall. It is the leftmost of four bouldering ledges in the central cluster at Lincoln Woods, a steep overhanging recess on coarse granite. Of its roughly two dozen problems, only a few are easy; the bulk are strong V7 to V9 lines, with a couple harder than that and a single V12 at the top end. Nearby boulders offer plenty of gentler problems and many south-facing lines, so the cluster works as a social meeting point, and this cave is where people head once they are warm and want something steep and powerful.

ri_try_again_boulder.blurb: Try Again Boulder is a celebrated single block in Lincoln Woods State Park, and a place where a long session is easy to fill. The front is a flat, overhanging face of small crimps, while the right side eases off into more positive incut holds. About two dozen problems, many with named variations, run from V1 up to V10, with plenty in the mid grades. Detailed sequences can be hard to pin down, so expect some trial and error on the micro beta. The granite is sharply textured and rough on skin. It sits a ten-minute walk beyond the warm-up area, past another popular boulder.

ri_ship_s_prow.blurb: Ship's Prow is one of the friendliest blocks at Lincoln Woods, a good boulder to loosen up on before moving to harder terrain nearby. Around two dozen problems fill it, mostly from VB to V4, with a rare harder line near V6. A well-known V1 traverse across the nose draws steady traffic, so the block often has company, and the easy grades make it a fine pick for newer boulderers and groups with mixed ability. It stands beside the trail that leads on to the Try Again Boulder, in the shade of the woods, on rough granite with sharp texture.

ri_iron_cross_boulder.blurb: Iron Cross Boulder is the first block most climbers meet when they walk up into the warm-up cluster at Lincoln Woods. It has a broad face on one side and a shorter, steeper wall on the other, giving about twenty problems between V0 and V10. A cluster of V4 lines forms the core, with a handful of easy beginner-level problems and a few strong V7 to V10 lines for those after a challenge. The granite is coarse and sharply textured. Because it sits at the top of the approach trail and beside several other boulders, it is a natural place to start a day or meet friends.

ri_heart_boulder.blurb: Heart Boulder is a well-liked block near the start of the Lincoln Woods boulder field, one of the shorter walks in from the paved loop and close to the warm-up area and other good boulders. It holds twenty problems from VB through V9, with a fairly even spread: several easy lines, a solid block of V4 problems, and a few of the harder grades near the top. The area is best known for a classic V4+ that sees repeat attempts from visitors. Rock is coarse granite with sharp texture, and the woods give it a calm setting.
